tools.name: reschedule_call

action.description: 'list' to fetch available slots; 'book' to book the slot the candidate chose.

call_id.description: Internal call reference from the prompt variable call_id. Never ask the candidate for it.

slot_iso.description: For action 'book': the exact value from slot_isos returned by the 'list' call for the slot the candidate chose. For action 'list': empty string "".

tools.description: Book a callback when the candidate cannot talk now or asks to be called at another time (busy, driving, in a meeting, noisy, unwell, 'call me later', 'call me tomorrow', 'kal call karna', 'abhi nahi'). First call with action='list' to get available callback slots, offer up to 3 of them, then call with action='book' and the exact slot_iso the candidate chose. Only confirm a callback after a 'book' result with booked=true. Do not call this for any other reason.
